security_audit.summary: AI review found the static findings are documentation false positives, not malicious behavior. The skill contains public GWAS Catalog API examples, public EBI links, Markdown formatting, and an explicit user-requested download example. No prompt injection, credential access, covert exfiltration, or unauthorized command execution was found.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid hammering the API with rapid consecutive requests
- Variant IDs: `rs` numbers (e.g., rs7903146) or `variant_id` format
- `size` parameter: Number of results per page
- `_links` in response: URLs for next/previous pages

content.value_statement: Genetic association research needs precise links between variants, traits, studies, and summary statistics. This skill guides GWAS Catalog searches, API queries, and interpretation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains GWAS Catalog studies, associations, variants, traits, and identifier formats.
Builds REST API queries for studies, variants, traits, genes, associations, and genomic regions.
Guides retrieval of p-values, effect sizes, risk alleles, ancestry notes, and study metadata.
Describes summary statistics access through the API, website, and public EBI downloads.
Provides workflows for disease research, variant review, gene analysis, and systematic evidence synthesis.
limitations: It does not provide clinical genetic diagnosis or medical advice.
Results depend on GWAS Catalog curation and available deposited summary statistics.
Live queries require network access to external GWAS Catalog services.
Example code may need adjustment if public API endpoints change.

use_cases.title: Review Variant Associations
use_cases.description: Find reported traits, p-values, effect sizes, and studies for a known rs identifier.

use_cases.title: Map Trait Evidence
use_cases.description: Collect genome-wide significant variants for a disease or phenotype using EFO terms.

use_cases.title: Plan Summary Statistics Work
use_cases.description: Identify available GWAS summary statistics and choose API or bulk download access.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Variant
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up rs7903146 in the GWAS Catalog and summarize associated traits, p-values, and source studies.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Trait
prompt_templates.prompt: Find GWAS Catalog associations for type 2 diabetes. Include EFO identifiers, lead variants, and strongest evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build an API Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reproducible GWAS Catalog API workflow for a gene-centered association review of APOE.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Evidence Sources
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced synthesis across catalog and summary statistics data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare curated associations and available summary statistics for Parkinson disease. Note limitations and follow-up checks.

output_examples.output: The response summarizes reported traits, strongest p-values, effect alleles, nearby genes, and linked studies for the variant.

output_examples.input: Review GWAS evidence for body mass index.
output_examples.output: The response lists the relevant trait identifiers, major association patterns, study metadata, and cautions about ancestry coverage.

output_examples.input: Plan access to summary statistics for GCST001234.
output_examples.output: The response explains how to check availability, choose API or bulk access, and document the access date.

best_practices: Use EFO identifiers when possible to avoid ambiguous trait names.
Check ancestry, sample size, replication status, and publication details before interpretation.
Use pagination, delays, and caching for large API queries.
anti_patterns: Do not treat GWAS associations as direct clinical predictions.
Do not combine effect sizes across studies without checking allele harmonization.
Do not make high-volume API requests when bulk downloads are more appropriate.

faq.question: What database does this skill use?
faq.answer: It focuses on the NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog and its public REST and summary statistics services.

faq.question: Can it look up a single SNP?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide searches by rs identifier and summarize reported trait associations.

faq.question: Can it search by disease or trait?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports trait searches using names or EFO identifiers when available.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: The referenced GWAS Catalog APIs are public and do not require authentication.

faq.question: Can it download full summary statistics?
faq.answer: It explains public access options, but downloads require user approval and local storage planning.

faq.question: Can it provide medical advice?
